rows.grounds: manner adverb indicating the prescribed procedure
numerical compound denoting one hundred and eight repetitions
absolutive expressing completion of mantra recitation prior to offering
instrumental pronoun referring to the means or formula of offering
prescriptive optative enjoining ritual dedication of the recitation

items.question: By what concluding act must a one-hundred-eightfold recitation be ritually dedicated?
premises: The prescribed recitation is performed in this manner.
The recitation is completed one hundred and eight times.
A completed recitation requires a ritual act of dedication.
items.inference: Therefore, after reciting thus one hundred and eight times, one should dedicate the recitation with this.
uncertainties: The referent of anena is not explicitly specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having thus recited one hundred and eight times, one should offer the recitation with this.
